description: Stereo delay with two independent lines that can run side by side, ping-pong or cross-feed, each with its own time and tone, plus freeze, reverse, pitch shift and diffusion

params.text: Sets the echo time of its side, from a hundredth of the module's buffer at fully counter-clockwise to all of it at fully clockwise
Attenuates and inverts the Echo jack of its side, -1 to 1; with nothing patched there it does nothing at all
Sets the tone of the echoes on its side: the filter corner runs from 300Hz to 1200Hz and the output crossfades from the lowpass to the highpass across the same travel
Attenuates and inverts the Light/Dark jack of its side, -1 to 1; with nothing patched there it does nothing at all
Sets how much of each line's output goes back into it, 0 at fully counter-clockwise up to 1.1 at fully clockwise, which is past unity and will build rather than fade
Transposes the echoes, -12 to 12; the jack can carry it a further octave either way
Diffuses the echoes through a chain of all-pass filters, from none at fully counter-clockwise to the full smear at fully clockwise
Stops new audio going into the delay lines, so what is in them circles round for as long as it is held
Plays the contents of the delay lines backwards
Sets how much of the input signal reaches the outputs, 0 to 1
Sets how much of the delayed signal reaches the outputs, 0 to 1
Steps between Dual-Mono, where each side feeds only itself, Ping-Pong, where each side feeds the other, and Cross-Feed, where each keeps 57 per cent of its echoes and takes 43 per cent of the other's

inputs.text: Shifts the echo time of its side, scaled by its own attenuverter; 5V at full attenuverter moves the time across the whole buffer
Divided by 5, scaled by its own attenuverter, and added to the Light/Dark knob of its side
Divided by 5 and multiplied by the Feedback knob, the total clamped to 1.1; with no cable the knob is used on its own
Added to the Pitch knob, the total clamped to -2 and 2
Divided by 5 and multiplied by the Scatter knob; with no cable the knob is used on its own
Above 1V it stops new audio going into the delay lines, and a cable here replaces the Freeze button
Above 1V it plays the contents of the delay lines backwards, and a cable here replaces the Reverse button
Divided by 5 and added to the Dry knob, the total clamped to 0 and 1
Divided by 5 and added to the Wet knob, the total clamped to 0 and 1
The left audio input; with no cable the left line gets 0V
The right audio input; with no cable the right line takes the left input

outputs.text: The left line's echoes mixed with the left input, at the Dry and Wet settings
The right line's echoes mixed with the right input, at the Dry and Wet settings

notes: in Ping-Pong mode with nothing in the right input, only the left line is fed the dry signal and the right line carries nothing but what the left one hands it
the two cliff faces light up in time with each line's echoes, their colour set by that line's echo time
the delay lines keep their contents through a Freeze, so freezing and then turning the echo time gives the sound of the buffer being read at a new rate
every jack is monophonic, whatever is patched in
